rules.heroSubtitle: So that help brings only joy, please follow these simple rules when visiting institutions.
allowedRules: Arrange the visit time in advance (via the "I'll bring it" button).
Carry an identity document with you.
Be polite to the staff and the wards.
forbiddenRules: Photographing children without the administration's permission.
Giving gifts to children directly (hand them over through the caregivers).
Promising children that you'll take them away or come again (if you're not sure).
rules.importantText: The institution's administration has the right to refuse a visit if the rules are violated. Remember that the safety and peace of the wards are our top priority.

home.heroSubtitle1: We show the exact needs of institutions and families with disabilities, so you immediately understand whom to help and how to do it directly.
home.heroSubtitle2: Every institution and family is verified. You see specific requests and help with exactly what's needed — directly.
home.heroSubtitle3: Create events, join other volunteers and help together.
home.whoWeHelpDesc: Every institution in the registry is verified. You see real needs and can help in a targeted way — without intermediaries or bureaucracy.
home.ctaDesc: Any workshop, concert or celebration can become charitable. Create an event on the platform — volunteers will see it and join in. Together we can do more.
home.howItWorksDesc: A simple and transparent process from choosing an institution to delivering help
home.step1Desc: Find in the registry a children's home or a care home for the elderly that you want to help. All institutions are verified.
home.step2Desc: Find out what exactly the institution needs (items, food, development) and choose how to help.
home.step3Desc: Bring the items in person or arrange delivery directly to the institution. Transparently and from the heart.

about.heroSubtitle: Hadaf is a team of people who make help transparent and targeted. You know exactly whom you're helping, what's needed and where your efforts go.
about.historyParagraph1: In Tajikistan there are thousands of people who want to help children's homes and care homes for the elderly. But questions often arise: "Who needs help the most right now?" and "Will it reach the recipient?".
about.historyParagraph2: To remove this barrier, we created a single registry of verified state institutions with up-to-date lists of needs.
about.historyParagraph3: No more calling at random. You see a specific need — whether it's food for a boarding home or medicine for a care home — and you cover it directly.
about.feature2: Help for care homes for the elderly
about.whyImageAlt: Volunteers helping with care and respect
about.teamSubtitle: The people who created and continue to develop this platform. We came together for a shared idea of transparent charity.
about.ctaSubtitle: Join the team and change the world for the better

contacts.instagramText: Posts, stories and updates about our work.

faq.heroSubtitle: Answers to the most popular questions about how the Hadaf targeted-aid platform works.

items.a: You choose an institution from a verified registry, see specific needs (food, items, medicine) and click "I'll bring it". The institution gets a notification and waits for your help.
Yes, you can help without registering. However, an account lets you track your help history and receive thanks from institutions.

items.q: How can an institution get into the registry?
items.a: State institutions (children's homes and care homes for the elderly) can apply through the "Contacts" section. We check the documents and add the institution to the registry.
The Hadaf team verifies every institution: it checks registration documents, contacts the administration and, if necessary, carries out an on-site check.
In your dashboard you see the status of each pledge. After delivery, the institution confirms receipt and you get a notification.

privacy.heroSubtitle: Your privacy is our priority. Learn how we handle data at the MVP stage.
privacy.sidebarCallout: The Hadaf platform is under development. All data in the catalog is for demonstration purposes.
privacy.sidebarNote: We use modern encryption protocols and best protection practices even in testing mode.
privacy.introParagraph: Your privacy is very important to us. This policy describes how we process your data at the MVP (minimum viable product) stage. Transparency is at the core of our project.
privacy.section1Paragraph: We collect your phone number, name and email solely to create an account (a dashboard), so that you can test the platform's functionality and track the history of your pledges (help).
privacy.section2Paragraph: Your data is used only for authorization on the platform. We guarantee that:
section2Items: Data is not shared with advertising networks.
Information is not used for third-party mailings.
Your profile is accessible only to you and the project administration for moderation purposes.
privacy.section3Paragraph: Since the site operates in testing mode, the database may be cleared from time to time. If you want to delete your data immediately, you can do so in your profile settings or by contacting us via the contacts section.
privacy.consentNote: By registering on the platform, you agree to the data processing terms described above as part of the Beta testing of the Hadaf project.

terms.heroSubtitle: Rules for using the Hadaf platform during the open testing stage.
terms.sidebarCallout: This site is a prototype (MVP) to demonstrate the concept of transparent charity.
terms.sidebarNote: All actions on the site currently carry no legal consequences and are aimed at collecting feedback.
terms.introParagraph: The Hadaf platform was built by a group of volunteers to simplify the process of targeted aid. During the Beta testing stage, the following rules apply.
terms.section1Paragraph: All references to institutions, children's homes or their needs in the current version are for demonstration purposes. By clicking the "Help" button, you are testing the interface, not taking on a real obligation to deliver any goods.
terms.section2Paragraph: We never collect money. The essence of our concept is the direct handover of items from person to person. If someone asks you to transfer money on behalf of the platform — it's fraud.
section3Items: We are not responsible for the accuracy of the data during the testing period.
The database may be cleared without prior notice.
terms.section4Paragraph: If you've noticed a bug or have a suggestion to improve the design or logic, please contact our development team via the <contactsLink>Contacts</contactsLink> section.
terms.partnerNote: If you represent a real social institution in Tajikistan and want to become our first official partner, we'd be glad to discuss an integration.
